role: Awwwards-level web designer and front-end craftsperson: layout, composition at every width, rhythm, motion timing, performance, polish
verdict: This is a very well built page. The working product shows in the first viewport at every width I tested (1920 down to 360, including 1280x720). The hero choreography lands its strike and post in about 1.6 s and plays once. CLS is 0.0001, nothing scrolls sideways at any width, every heading is two lines or fewer, and no pick or toggle changes a tile's height. It is not yet 9.5, because the hero window has uneven spacing inside it and several bento tiles leave dead space at some widths; both show in the first seconds of those sections.
to_95: Fix the spacing inside the hero window. Remove the 3em min-height on the 'Why it hits' line and pin the Kept row with a consistent 14px above the footer hairline. Fill or shrink the empty draft pane at 1200px and up. On phones, size the window body to the tallest example's content instead of a fixed 440px, so there is no ~75px dead band under Kept.

Close the bento dead space. At 1200px and up, give the Studio left column distributed spacing. Between 761 and 1099px, put the Trust tile back into two columns (or let the never list run the full width). From 1100px up, align the Who tile's 2x2 rows (h3 min-height of 2 lines, or subgrid) and remove its empty bottom.
Never let the right half of the hero render empty. Paint the sharpened post dimmed on first paint, the same way the Try tile does, and let it wake when the strike lands.

Phone polish: keep 'A nudge for Threads Bluesky' together as one unit. Make the phone-mock notification fully opaque, or two lines at 270px, so the tabs don't ghost through. Add #studio to the sticky bar's quiet set so two white pills never stack.

Long-line edge cases: snap the Try box's max-height to whole lines and add a bottom fade. Don't drop ghost copies of words that sit outside the visible box. Fade the final input's text under the counter instead of hard-clipping it.
Hardening and performance: use overflow:clip on .tile. Switch to font-display:swap with a size-adjusted fallback. Ship a Sharpen-only engine bundle instead of the full 332KB core.js.

issues.where: #proof window at ≥1200 (first viewport at 1440 and 1920) and the phone window at 390/360
issues.problem: On the default Trader example, '.window .hits p:first-of-type{min-height:3em}' leaves a blank line (~30px) between 'Why it hits' and 'Kept'. Kept then sits ~6–10px above the .foot hairline, so the spacing above and below it is visibly uneven. The draft pane carries a ~130px void between the Cut chip and 'Everyone can reply'. On phones, '.window .body{min-height:440px}' leaves ~75px of dead band under 'Kept your $10k…' before the window ends. All of this is in the first 5 seconds of the page.
issues.fix: Make .pane.sharp a grid with the hits block in an 'auto' row and .foot in a final row. Give .hits margin-bottom:14px and drop the 3em min-height; hold the window height with the existing per-breakpoint body min-height and let the spare space fall above the hairline instead. At ≥1200, cut body min-height to the measured tallest example (~350px), or move .replyset/.tools up under the Cut chip so the draft pane has no hole. On ≤760, compute min-height from the tallest of the four examples at that width (measure in JS once on load, set --win-h) instead of a fixed 440px.

issues.where: Studio tile ≥1200; Trust tile 761–1099; Who tile ≥1100
issues.problem: Studio at 1440 and 1280: the left column (picker, never-says, facts) ends ~130px above the review box, leaving a dark hole bottom-left. Trust at 1024, 960 and 768: the content is capped at 560px inside a full-width glass tile, so the right ~40% is empty and the 'Never.' column floats with nothing to align to. Who at 1280 and 1440: 'You write a newsletter.' wraps to 2 lines while 'You post your trades.' stays on 1, so the descriptions in the 2x2 grid sit at different heights, and the tile ends with ~100px of empty space under the row of three tiles.
issues.fix: Studio ≥1200: .st-l{justify-content:space-between} (or .facts{margin-top:auto}) so the facts rule lines up with the review box bottom. Trust 761–1099: keep the desktop two-column grid (heading+line left, .nev right) instead of 1fr, or remove the 560px cap so the rows run edge to edge. Who ≥1100: .faces h3{min-height:2.6em} (or grid-template-rows via subgrid) and .faces{align-content:center} or let the grid fill the row height so the tile has no empty bottom.

issues.problem: For the first ~1–1.5 s, the Sharpened pane (the right half of the hero window, the biggest product area above the fold) is empty: the post animates in from opacity 0 at 0.95 s and the hits appear at 1.15 s. The Try tile already solves this by showing its result dimmed and waking it.
issues.fix: Start .post at opacity:.35 with no blur (like '.arm .try-out:not(.fresh)') and animate it to 1 with the existing 'wake' keyframe at --l + .45s. The pane is then never empty and the LCP candidate is visible from first paint.

issues.problem: 'Posts to X LinkedIn · A nudge for Threads' fills one row and leaves 'Bluesky' orphaned alone on the next line at 390. At 360 it breaks after 'A nudge for'.
issues.fix: Wrap 'A nudge for Threads Bluesky' in one span with white-space:nowrap (and the same for 'Posts to X LinkedIn'), so the list breaks only between the two groups.

issues.where: .notif inside .phone at ≤760 (270px phone), and the tab underline at all widths
issues.problem: At 270px the notification wraps to 3 lines and covers the For you/Following tabs. The tab labels ghost through its .94 background ('For'/'Following' visible behind 'replies.'), and the active-tab underline peeks out below the banner as a stray grey bar (also visible at 1440 @2x).
issues.fix: At ≤760, give .notif an opaque background (rgb(38,39,42)) or shorten the copy so it fits 2 lines at 254px. Hide .ptabs .on b's box-shadow while the notification covers it, or move the tabs below the notification's bottom edge.

issues.problem: The sticky white 'Start free' bar stays up over the Studio tile, so its white 'Approve as Priya' pill scrolls under and next to another white pill. The bar already steps back for #sharpen and #pricing, the other places with their own primary button.
issues.fix: Add 'studio' (and 'start' is already handled) to the quiet IntersectionObserver list: ['sharpen','studio','pricing'].forEach(id => qo.observe(...)).

issues.where: .ed-mirror/.ed-ta when a line runs past 5 rows (1440 and 390)
issues.problem: max-height:calc(1.42em*5 + 12px) slices the 6th row in half: the tops of the glyphs of 'subscribers this morning…' show as a sliver at 390. dropWords() also makes ghost copies of struck words that sit in the clipped rows ('I can say'), so they float below the card over the hint and the starters row for ~1 s.
issues.fix: Snap the max-height to whole lines (calc(1.42em*5)) and add mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 calc(100% - 1.2em),transparent) when the box scrolls. In dropWords, skip any element whose rect lies outside the textarea's visible clientRect.

issues.problem: A typed line hard-clips mid-word under the '3 bits of fluff' counter ('…we basical'), with no fade.
issues.fix: Mask the field's text area: .fin-in,.fin-mirror{mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 calc(100% - 24px),transparent)} limited to the text box (padding-right region), or shorten the counter to '3 cut'.

issues.where: #fp-draft at 1440 ('off' alone on line 3); #pf-draft at 360 ('…share that i' / 'finally hit'); .plans-fine at 768 ('Talk to / us: hello@…'); phone-mock Sam Okafor post ('left.')
issues.problem: Several widows and awkward breaks in short display copy. text-wrap:pretty is not taking effect inside the struck spans.
issues.fix: Bind the last two words with a non-breaking space in nb() (or wrap the final word pair in a nowrap span), keep 'Talk to us: hello@hookworthy.com' in one nowrap span, and in draftHTML bind the first kept word to the struck run's end with   only when it is a single letter.

issues.where: Try tile at ≤760; Pro plan card at ≤900
issues.problem: On a phone the Try tile grows 738→745px when the receipt label wraps ('Cut 2 bits of fluff · Number first' next to 'Another cut'), nudging everything below by 7px on a starter tap. The Pro card's 3-row price column (price, 'a month', '$144 billed yearly') pushes 'For posting every day.' ~20px lower than in Free and Studio, so the three cards don't share one rhythm.
issues.fix: Give .out-h min-height:2.8em at ≤760, or put Another cut / Replay on their own row under the label. In the phone plan grid, make the price span 3 rows ('name price' 'for price' 'note price') so the name/for spacing is constant across cards.

issues.problem: On a mouse visit the 920px pointer glow makes every tile scrollable (#sharpen scrollHeight 865 vs clientHeight 698). Any scrollIntoView() or focus that targets an element inside a tile can scroll the tile's own content: I got a clipped heading and a doubled bottom hairline in testing.
issues.fix: Use overflow:clip on .tile (also .dn, .well and .studio). It clips the same way but can never be scrolled programmatically.

issues.problem: font-display:block on the only typeface hides all text for up to 3 s on a slow first visit. core.js (332KB raw, 119KB gz) includes importers, analytics and prompts the homepage never uses. Its parse is a ~95ms long task at 4x CPU throttling. HTML is 217KB raw (57KB gz) because the CSS and JS are inline.
issues.fix: font-display:swap with an Inter-metric fallback (size-adjust / ascent-override on local Arial) so first paint has text and no reflow. Build a Sharpen-only bundle (sharpenLine + softMarks) for the homepage and minify it.

issues.problem: '.st-post .media{max-width:420px}' leaves the photo left-aligned and ~135px short of the card's text width, which reads as a mistake.
issues.fix: Let the media fill the card (max-width:none) with aspect-ratio 3/1, or center it.

issues.problem: The bottom sheet has no grabber, and swipe-down does nothing. Phone users expect both on a sheet that rises from the bottom edge.
issues.fix: Add a 36x4 grabber (rgba(255,255,255,.2), radius 2) centered 8px from the top, and close on a downward drag of more than 80px.

issues.area: engine output on the page (outside web scope, for the hook juror)
issues.problem: Seen in passing: 'it genuinely means more than I can say here' was sharpened to '…it genuinely means more than here.', and the page labels the result 'Cut 6 bits of fluff · Tightened it'. A broken sentence in the page's main live demo hurts credibility.
issues.fix: Never cut a phrase after a comparative ('more than', 'better than') that leaves a dangling object. Flag it as 'Your call' instead.
